summary: # Ralphmode Permission Profiles This file contains the concrete presets referenced by `ralphmode/SKILL.md`. Read only the section for the platform you are configuring. ## Shared safety baseline Apply these rules regardless of platform: - Scope automation to one repo or disposable sandbox. - Block secrets by default: `.env*`, `secrets/**`, credential exports, production config. - Block destructive shell by default: `rm -rf`, `sudo`, blind remote scripts. - Keep verification outside the permission shortcut itself. ## Claude Code
